reaction: The empty ATP site makes the next step clearer.
reason: The installed pump has an ATP-binding site, matching the remaining goal of moving particles.

reason: The ribosome picture shows amino acids matching the pieces of its growing protein, so these are a clear pair for the remaining goal.

reason: The supplied ribosome points to ATP for the protein-making work.

effect: The ribosome used the building blocks and ATP to make proteins, completing the remaining goal. The result connects food, energy and DNA instructions.
reaction: Seeing the protein chains fold into different shapes was satisfying.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making proteins was most worthwhile because it connected the building blocks, ATP and the RNA message to a finished product.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed direct ATP-and-pump attempt was confusing: the ATP picture pointed to the pump, but the pump first had to be installed in the membrane.

surprise.text: I was surprised that ATP could not be combined directly with the pump, even though the picture showed an ATP-binding site.

arbitrary.text: The installation prerequisite initially felt unclear rather than pointless; the pump picture did show that it fits across a membrane.

continue.text: I would choose to continue because connecting familiar ideas about food and DNA to cell jobs was interesting, especially when the pictures made the next step understandable.
